# DRAFT-1 — Shoppers can share a basket

## Problem

Shoppers want a friend to see their basket.

## Scope / Non-goals

- A shopper can send a link to their basket.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: a shared link opens the basket read-only.

## Technical Approach

A signed link.

## Risks

- A leaked link shows the basket.
